title: Making LLMs Reliable When It Matters Most: A Five-Layer Architecture for High-Stakes Decisions

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative assessment using simulated high-stakes decision scenarios (venture vignettes) across 7 frontier-grade LLMs to detect and correct linguistic markers of reflexive agreement, flattering language, hedging, and premature consensus during human-AI interaction.

bias_targets.target: Cognitive bias (Confirmation bias, Sunk-cost fallacy, Anchoring)
bias_targets.methodology: Implementation of a 5-layer protection architecture and 7-stage calibration sequence to actively monitor, challenge, and prevent mutually reinforcing human and AI cognitive traps at the point of commitment during strategic decision-making.
